span.div:
Views room photos; books a
room type or a specific room
on web or mobile.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Front desk (bookings,
check-in / out), hotel
manager, housekeeping
supervisor (cart queues).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Clean and repair rooms in
priority order from cart
devices.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Guests pick a specific room;
keeps room-nights and room
status; directs housekeeping
by priority.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Prices, non-pool stays,
settlement, refunds, reports.
No API, files only; blocks a
pool only we sell.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Mobile keys via vendor API; a
key in the phone works even
while we are down.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Hosted payment page; card
pre-authorisation at booking.
We never see card data.
